# CANDIDATE: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE4_TOP_KEEPER

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture the asymmetric edge in J's bearish reversal days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) while minimizing losses on loser days. The shotgun_scalper_stage4 grinder optimized for edge_capture by tuning exit parameters (TP/SL stops, time stop, chandelier arm, volume filter) to improve win rate and expectancy on qualifying setups. The edge exists due to persistent mean-reversion in SPY 0DTE puts after intraday rejection candles with volume confirmation.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers on 3-bar VWAP continuation patterns with volume ratio > 1.2 (vol_ratio_threshold). Strike selection is ITM-2 puts (strike_offset=2). Exit logic: take profit at 75% of premium (tp_premium_pct=0.75), stop loss at 35% of premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35), time-based exit after 12 minutes (time_stop_min=12), and chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% of the adverse excursion (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6). Positions use 3-contract minimum sizing per risk-rules.md.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Backtest appears to use 3-contract minimum sizing (per risk-rules.md). For a $25K account (minimum live size per playbook), this scales to ~12.5 contracts (25K/2K * 3). Wide_pnl of $22,084.2 implies ~$1,766 per contract traded over 1,199 trades. Realistic account size needed: $25K+ to avoid position sizing constraints.
2. **Sample bias:** Keeper selected from multi-parameter grid (shotgun_scalper_stage4). Sample size: 1,199 trades over ~16 months. Selection bias high (top 1 of 5 keepers from stage4). Overfit risk significant due to optimizer chasing noise in high-frequency signal.
